title: Entanglement Transfer Dynamics in a Two-Leg Spin Ladder Under a Selective Magnetic Field
summary: We investigate the dynamical transfer of bipartite entanglement through a two-leg spin-1/2 ladder governed by the anisotropic Heisenberg (XXZ-type) model with a selective magnetic field applied exclusively to the mediating rungs. Starting from a maximally entangled initial rung pair, we demonstrate high-fidelity entanglement transfer to the terminal pair (F_max = 0.9998 for N = 3 rung pairs), with the intermediate rungs remaining effectively disentangled throughout.
